responsibility: This header is the public prototype and hook declaration interface for the SPARC backend implementation. It declares target initialization, option override, prologue/epilogue expansion, compare/move/call emission, PIC and TLS helpers, atomic and vector expansion routines, output helpers, scheduling/branch-cost logic, and the errata pass factory, allowing sparc.cc, generated md code, and other GCC subsystems to call SPARC target services consistently.
